item.title: [AI & I by Every] How a Professional Writer Writes With AI
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:31 Hey, it's Dan Shipper, and this week I'm excited to share a very special episode of AI and Dive. In this episode, we're previewing the release of an experimental new plugin called Compound Writing, which helps you write with AI the way that we do internally. It's inspired by Kieran Klassen's Compound Engineering, and it's built by one of our staff writers, Katie Parrott.
